adequacy_evidence.quote: Scientific adequacy: not supported. The reported absence of a corrected vmPFC finding rests on a group test that counts zero-coded noncoverage as observed zero coefficients in voxels admitted at only 90% participant support; this can change the group t statistics and max-T null, and no complete-case or missingness sensitivity is reported.

hypothesis_conclusion.quote: In the NARPS equal-indifference group, the gain-effect maps do **not** support a positive vmPFC response to increasing potential gain under a whole-brain corrected test.
